item.text: There is no release package yet. Startup currently parses and compares versions in `main.go`, and `info.Flipt.Version` is blank for dev builds because it comes from a release-only parsed value. I’m moving the fetch and comparison into `internal/release`, then wiring its result into startup logs, the info endpoint metadata, and telemetry gating.

item.text: The startup flow now uses `release.Is` and the release package’s result, keeps the current version populated for dev builds, and includes the latest URL in server metadata. I’ve also added the required non-release telemetry debug message; I’m checking formatting/build behavior and running the focused existing Go package tests now.

The release and info packages compile, and the existing telemetry tests pass. The command package is still compiling; once it finishes I’ll inspect the final diff and confirm no other callers depend on the removed startup helpers.

item.text:
Implemented the release and startup changes.

- Added [internal/release/check.go](/app/internal/release/check.go) for release detection and update checks. Check failures log a warning and return control to startup.
- Updated [main.go](/app/cmd/flipt/main.go) to report update status in the configured output mode and disable telemetry for CI or non-release builds.
- Added the latest release URL to [info.Flipt](/app/internal/info/flipt.go) metadata.
- Recorded progress in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

`go test ./internal/release ./internal/info ./internal/telemetry ./cmd/flipt` passed. The release, info, and command packages have no existing tests; telemetry tests passed.
